import errno
import os
import pty
import subprocess

cases = [
    (["--paging=never", "--plain"], {}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--paging=never", "-p"], {}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--plain", "--paging=never"], {}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--plain"], {"BAT_PAGING": "never"}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--plain"], {"BAT_OPTS": "--paging=never"}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--paging=always", "--plain"], {}, "pager-output\r\n"),
    (["-pp"], {}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["--paging=always", "-pp"], {}, "hello world\r\n"),
    (["-pp", "--paging=always"], {}, "pager-output\r\n"),
]
for args, extra_env, expected in cases:
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("BAT_")}
    env.update(BAT_CONFIG_PATH="/dev/null", BAT_PAGER="echo pager-output")
    env.update(extra_env)
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        ["target/debug/bat", "--color=never", *args, "tests/examples/test.txt"],
        stdout=slave, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env,
    )
    os.close(slave)
    _, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10)
    output = b""
    try:
        while True:
            data = os.read(master, 4096)
            if not data:
                break
            output += data
    except OSError as error:
        if error.errno != errno.EIO:
            raise
    finally:
        os.close(master)
    assert process.returncode == 0, (args, stderr)
    assert output.decode() == expected, (args, extra_env, output)
print(f"Verified {len(cases)} real-terminal paging, environment, and configuration cases")
PY
